description: S59 T7 (EV16, TD2) — the agent's ONE ask, answered. environment_propose_restrict is a catalog tool and this is its socket twin: the same records service that answers the tool answers the method, so the bytes are the same answer rather than a second rendering of it (rule 4). What the answer is: a PROPOSAL row, `status: proposed`, authored by the AGENT the step belongs to (`createdByKind: agent` — the ask is the model's, and saying so is the audit), carrying the environment it asks about, the FULL proposed spec, the baseline the service READ (never a `revision` the caller typed), and the agent's reason. The `note` is the fixed inertness statement — `protocol.PolicyProposeInertNote`, one definition in the code and this fixture its wire copy — because an ask constrains nothing: no environment row moved, no revision advanced, nothing is enforced until a person runs the `command` this answer names. A proposal that LOOSENS is refused at create by the same door (see propose-restrict-refuses-a-stolen-actor.json for the door's other half), so what stands here is a tightening or nothing.
